subject: E4.json shape changed (grid.py)
body: results/prereg/E4.json (5daf3e0): shared_run_settings now has split_file (a research option, so grid passes it). Model flags are not in shared_run_settings. The prereg names models_config: configs/models.json at the top level, and scripts/e4_commands.py turns it into --generator/--target/--judge via models_config.research_args. If grid is used for E4 it will need the same, or its runs get the CLI default models. I haven't touched grid.py.
